name: tail
description: Print the last lines of files

name: -f
--follow
options.description: Print the file as it grows [possible values: descriptor, name]

options.name: --pid
options.description: With -f, terminate after process ID, PID dies

name: -q
--quiet
options.description: Never output headers giving file names [aliases: --silent]

name: -s
--sleep-interval
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between polling the file when running with -f

options.name: --max-unchanged-stats
options.description: Reopen a FILE which has not changed size after N (default 5) iterations to see…

name: -v
--verbose
options.description: Always output headers giving file names

name: -z
--zero-terminated
options.description: Line delimiter is NUL, not newline

options.name: --use-polling
options.description: Disable 'inotify' support and use polling instead

options.name: --retry
options.description: Keep trying to open a file if it is inaccessible
